newsitem.title: USA: 3Dlabs Inc IPO 2.5 mln shrs at $11 each.
newsitem.headline: 3Dlabs Inc IPO 2.5 mln shrs at $11 each.

text.p: 3Dlabs Inc Ltd said on Tuesday it would launch an initial public offering of 2.5 million common shares at $11 per share.
It said it would sell 2.1 million shares, while some shareholders would sell 354,167 shares.
The company said it would use the net proceeds of the offering primarily for working capital and general corporate purposes.
3Dlabs Inc Ltd supplies high-performance, cost-effective graphics semiconductors, software and related technology designed to bring workstation-class 3D graphics to the personal computer.
